Name: Larder Storage Jar
Care Note: Season before first use by rinsing in warm water and drying the jar overnight upside down; the reactive oatmeal glaze pools thickly in the throwing rings and holds moisture, so for the first fortnight store the jar with the lid off and let it breathe. Dishwasher safe once seasoned, though hand washing keeps the pooled brown from dulling over time. Not for oven, freezer or direct flame, and never subject it to a sudden change of temperature, which will craze the interior.

Name: Coombe Teapot
Care Note: Warm the pot with a little hot water before brewing so the matte slate body is not shocked; empty and swill it after every use rather than leaving the leaf to stand, as tannin stains the unglazed rim of the lid seat. Hand wash only, never in the dishwasher, and never place it on a hob or in a microwave; the spout is thrown thin and will chip if it is knocked against a hard tap. Dry it fully before storing, and store it with the lid set ajar so the inside can air.
